# Pinterest India

> > Pinterest India: A visual discovery platform featuring curated content across anime art, design, fashion, wellness, and creative inspiration.

Pinterest India (in.pinterest.com) serves the Indian market with localized content spanning creative categories including anime and manga art (Jujutsu Kaisen, Tokyo Revengers), design resources (Shutterstock vectors, minimalist logos), fashion trends, DIY crafts, and wellness products. The platform aggregates visual inspiration with Russian-language content alongside English resources.

## Key Topics

- Anime and manga art (Jujutsu Kaisen, Tokyo Revengers, Bleach)
- Character drawings and sketches (Gojo Satoru, Mikey/Manjiro Sano)
- Minimalist logo design
- Black and white art and lineart
- Easy mini drawings and doodles
- Russian-language creative content
- Fashion trends (2025 bob haircuts)
- DIY crafts and knitting patterns
- Shutterstock design resources
- Brooklyn Tweed knitting
- Wellness and health (Maximus, GLP-1 treatments)
- Memorial and sympathy imagery
- Vector clipart and graphic design
- Crochet patterns

## Anime & Manga Art

- [Чб Аниме Рисунки](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/чб-аниме-рисунки/912463076083/): Black & white anime drawings featuring Gojo Satoru, Tokyo Revengers
- [Мини Рисункилегкие](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/мини-рисункилегкие/951037555428/): Easy mini drawings and doodles inspiration for beginners

## Design & Branding Resources

- [Logo System - 1000+ Logo Designs](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/351912466515077/): Logo System library with 1000+ minimalist and wordmark logo designs
- [TC/CT Monogram Logo Design](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/790311434615253473/): TC/CT monogram logo design from Shutterstock stock vectors
- [Shutterstock Tree Vector Clipart](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/392165080066793622/): Shutterstock vector tree clipart in pastel colors for design projects
- [Gelato Smart Wallets & Blockchain Platform](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/89649848824702690/): Gelato platform for smart wallets, gasless UX, and blockchain rollups

## Fashion & Beauty Trends

## DIY & Crafts

- [Связать Свитер Спицами Оверсайз](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/связать-свитер-спицами-оверсайз/927798993706/): Oversized sweater knitting patterns featuring Brooklyn Tweed designs
